decisions.reason: We keep Product C because it is close enough to our infrared-heating know-how to improve through in-house learning, but its weaker fit with our strategic move toward integrated and hydrogen-ready systems leaves a meaningful withdrawal risk.

We keep Product D because its use in industrial halls draws directly on our core engineering, installation and service knowledge, so market feedback can be absorbed and turned into refinements rather than exit.

We keep Product E because it combines strong relatedness to our gas infrared competence with clear alignment to our hydrogen-ready direction, making continued commercialization and learning highly attractive.
